name: localOffset
meaning: offset in the parent part's frame, *8, applied when flags & 0x08 (Instance_CalcWorldMatrix)

name: partIndex
meaning: parent model part whose matrix M[partIndex] is published into the link

name: flags
meaning: AttachLinkFlags (1 matrix valid, 2 parent already run through Scn_RenderIfVisible this frame - set on every child link at 0x56015d, tested at 0x5600da, cleared with 1 by Scenaric_RenderAll, 4 root rotation + part translation, 8 local offset, 0x10 extra rotation, 0x20 world offset)

name: flagsByte
meaning: flags as the plain byte: Scenaric_RenderAll clears matrixValid and parentDone together with one and-byte (& 0xFC at 0x5601ac), which the bitfield view would split into two stores

name: rot
meaning: extra rotation (4096/turn) applied with Mat44_SetRotXYZ when flags & 0x10

name: worldOffset
meaning: added to the child's translation *8 when flags & 0x20

name: parentInst
meaning: The parent's embedded render instance (parentObj + 4). Written by AttachLink_Alloc and zeroed by AttachLink_Free and AttachLink_InitPool. AttachLink_FindFirstChildSlot matches on it; ScnObject_Detach decrements (parentInst+0xE) through it.

name: parentObj
meaning: The parent scenaric object. Written by AttachLink_Alloc and zeroed by AttachLink_Free and AttachLink_InitPool. Scn_RenderIfVisible recurses into it to render the parent first.

name: matrix
meaning: parent-published D3D matrix for the attached child (translation row at +0x50/+0x54/+0x58). A real Mat44 member: StaticCtor_g_attachLinkStorage 0x55b1aa calls Mat44_Ctor 0x4077f0 on +0x20 of each of the 10 entries
